summary: This week's AI news highlights significant advancements in AI technology, including new watermarking systems, improved AI models, and increased adoption in various industries. However, concerns about AI misuse and surveillance also emerged.
insight: The increasing use of AI in various industries has led to a growing need for transparency and accountability, as evident from the introduction of watermarking systems and concerns about AI-generated content.
highlights: Anthropic's new watermarking system for Claude aims to prevent AI-generated content from being misused.
OpenAI's new 'Ultrafast' mode makes its GPT-5.6 model work 14x faster, targeting enterprise users.
Google's Gemini 3.7 Flash update brings substantial improvements to its AI-powered health coaching tools.
